svg.title: How a busy calendar affects participants
svg.desc: More fixtures: Organisers market another event to an already busy audience.. Less recovery: Players face extra demands during an existing season.. Uncertain benefit: Growing receipts do not establish that playing is more rewarding.

g.text: How a busy calendar affects participants
Organisers market another event to an already busy audience.
Players face extra demands during an existing season.
Growing receipts do not establish that playing is more rewarding.
